articles.headline: Inside India’s AI vision: Top bureaucrat on why big tech is pouring billions into India
articles.summary: India is emerging as a major AI and data-center hub, with global tech giants like Microsoft, Amazon & Google investing billions into tech infrastructure in the country. In an exclusive interview, the secretary of India's Ministry of Electronics and IT, S Krishnan, outlines India’s strategy.
